tool_schemas.name: get_latest_feed
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated user’s latest activity feed items, up to `count`, and includes a `cursor` you can pass back to fetch the next page (omit `cursor` to start from the newest). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `count` is not an integer or is out of range, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if your access token is missing/invalid or lacks permission to read the user feed. Raises RATE_LIMITED when you exceed API quotas.

count.description: Maximum number of feed items to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of feed items.

tool_schemas.name: add_bookmark
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new raindrop (bookmark) from `url`, optionally setting `title`, `description`, `tags`, and a destination `collection_id` (use "0" for Unsorted), and returns the created bookmark record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `url` is missing/invalid, `collection_id` does not match the allowed format, or `tags` is not an array of strings; raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you are not allowed to create bookmarks in the target collection. Raises NOT_FOUND if the specified collection does not exist, CONFLICT if the bookmark cannot be created due to a duplicate/constraint violation, and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed API quotas.

title.description: Title for the bookmark (if omitted, may be extracted from the URL).

description.description: Description or excerpt for the bookmark.

tags.description: List of tag names to apply to the bookmark.

collection_id.description: ID of the collection to add the bookmark to (use "0" for Unsorted).

tool_schemas.name: search_by_tag
tool_schemas.description: Lists bookmarks that have the given `tag`, optionally scoped to `collection_id` ("0" for all collections) and filtered by inclusive `from_date`/`to_date`; results are paged with `count` and a `cursor` returned for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `tag` is missing/empty, any date is not in YYYY-MM-DD format, `from_date` is after `to_date`, or `collection_id` does not match the allowed format. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you cannot search the requested collection(s), NOT_FOUND if a non-zero `collection_id` does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed API quotas.

tag.description: Tag name to filter bookmarks by.

collection_id.description: ID of the collection to search in (use "0" for all collections).

count.description: Maximum number of bookmarks to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: search_bookmarks
tool_schemas.description: Performs full-text search over bookmarks for `query`, optionally scoped to `collection_id` ("0" for all collections) and filtered by inclusive `from_date`/`to_date`; returns up to `count` results per page and a `cursor` for pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query` is missing/empty, any date is not in YYYY-MM-DD format, `from_date` is after `to_date`, or `collection_id` does not match the allowed format. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you cannot search the requested collection(s), NOT_FOUND if a non-zero `collection_id` does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed API quotas.

query.description: Search term to look for in bookmarks.

collection_id.description: ID of the collection to search in (use "0" for all collections).

count.description: Maximum number of bookmarks to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_user
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated user profile plus the effective OAuth scopes and current rate-limit/quota state for the presented access token. Refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the token is missing/invalid; may return RATE_LIMITED when you exceed the service limits.

include_scopes.description: When true, include the list of effective scopes granted to the access token.

include_limits.description: When true, include current rate-limit/quota consumption and reset timestamps, if available.

tool_schemas.name: list_collections
tool_schemas.description: Lists the authenticated user’s collections, excluding deleted collections by default, ordered by updated_at desc unless otherwise specified. Supports pagination and optional filtering by status. Refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the token is missing/invalid or lacks permission to read collections; may return RATE_LIMITED.

status.description: Filter collections by lifecycle status (deleted is never returned).

count.description: Maximum number of collections to return per page.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of collections.

tool_schemas.name: create_collection
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new collection for the authenticated user and returns the created collection record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid or if the title conflicts with an existing collection slug; refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the token is missing/invalid or lacks permission to create collections.

slug.description: Optional URL-friendly slug; if omitted the service generates one from title.

tool_schemas.name: update_collection
tool_schemas.description: Updates a collection owned by the authenticated user and returns the updated collection record. You may change mutable fields and drive lifecycle transitions via `status` (active↔archived, and active/archived→deleted). Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the collection does not exist, does not belong to you, or is deleted; VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields/transition; AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if not permitted.

id.description: ID of the collection to update.

status.description: Set the collection lifecycle status. Allowed transitions: active→archived/deleted, archived→active/deleted.

tool_schemas.name: get_bookmark
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single bookmark (raindrop) by id for the authenticated user and returns the bookmark record. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the bookmark does not exist, does not belong to you, or is trashed/deleted; AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the token is missing/invalid or lacks permission.

id.description: ID of the bookmark to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: update_bookmark
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing bookmark owned by the authenticated user and returns the updated bookmark record. Allows edits to metadata, moving between collections, replacing tags, and driving lifecycle transitions via `status` (active↔trashed, and active/trashed→deleted). Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the bookmark does not exist, does not belong to you, or is deleted; VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields/transition; AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if not permitted.

id.description: ID of the bookmark to update.

url.description: New URL for the bookmark (must be a valid URL).

collection_id.description: Move the bookmark to this collection (use "0" for Unsorted).

tags.description: Replace the bookmark’s tag set with these tag names (case-folded normalization; duplicates ignored).

status.description: Set the bookmark lifecycle status. Allowed transitions: active→trashed/deleted, trashed→active/deleted.
